sentences.text:
1. Heard Mr. M. Das, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. S.S. Pradhan, learned Addl.
Government Advocate for the State.
2.

This is an application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the petitioner in connection with Titilagarh P.S. Case No. 405 of 2022 corresponding to Special G.R. Case No. 18 of 2023 pending in the Court of the learned Addl.
Judge -cum- Special Court under POCSO Act,
Bolangir where charge sheet has been filed under Sections 363, 376(3), 376(2)(n), 109, 34 of IPC and Sections 6, 17 of POCSO Act

. 
3. Perusal of the rejection order dated 07.04.2023 reveals that the investigation was in progress at that time.
4. It is stated by Mr. Mahes Das, learned counsel for the petitioner that investigation had been completed in the meanwhile and chargesheet filed but he does not have a copy of the same.

5. As the investigation has been completed in the meanwhile and charge sheet has been filed,
without going into the merits of the bail application, the BLAPL is disposed of granting liberty to the petitioner to approach the learned Court below for bail afresh.
6. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
(Savitri Ratho) Judge Sukanta Signed by: SUKANTA KUMAR BEHERA
